title: Driver status badge and risk estimate panel with disclaimer
description: Implement web/src/components/StatusBadge.jsx and risk estimate indicator showing the current overall status (Normal, Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3, Monitoring Unavailable) with clear explanation that it is an experimental estimate rather than a medically validated score.
acceptanceCriteria: Displays active driver status banner with distinct colors: Normal (green), Stage 1 (yellow/amber), Stage 2 (orange), Stage 3 (red), Unavailable (gray)
Contains visible safety disclaimer: 'DrishtiDrive is an experimental driver-assistance prototype, not a medical or certified safety device' (PRD 1.0 & 6.5)
Shows em dashes ('—') for missing values when monitoring is unavailable

steps.details: Create web/src/components/StatusBadge.jsx receiving status and riskScore props.

steps.description: Add risk progress bar and disclaimer note
steps.details: Render smooth progress bar with label 'Drowsiness Risk Estimate (Calculated)'. Render disclaimer card with tooltip or small text.
Style status badges with high contrast, calm restrained colors, rounded pills, and accessible font sizes.
Run Playwright test verifying status badge text and disclaimer presence; capture screenshot to .agent/screenshots/TASK-25-1.png.

technicalNotes: Never display the risk score as a certified medical measurement (PRD FR-04).
Include both text and icon for accessibility (PRD 6.9).
